reader.requirement: At 1985, FUNCTION ANNUITY (argument-1 argument-2) with argument-1 equal to zero (in any written form: literal 0 or 0.000, a zero item of any usage, an expression evaluating to zero) must return an approximation of 1 / argument-2.

edition-consulted.switches: the D8 edition window: sig.IntroducedIn (85 for the 1989 Intrinsic Function module rows) against ctx.Edition.DialectLevel; COBOL1502/1503 outside it

construct numeric-function-identifier-operand-2002: at 85 a numeric function written where an identifier stands (DISPLAY/MOVE operand) is refused (COBOL0900), per 1985 IV.4.3.8.3.3 SR4; 2002+ accepts it. Not consulted inside COMPUTE

DialectBehavior.UnphrasedSizeErrorIsFatal: at 85 a COMPUTE with no SIZE ERROR phrase catches every size condition and continues (1985 VI.6.4.2 GR3); 2002+ takes the fatal-EC shape. Statement-level, around the function value, not inside it
num.StandardDecimal (arithmetic mode): the ARITHMETIC clause does not exist at 85, so 85 always takes the native arms, the same arms the latest edition takes by default

reader.edition-search: grep of IntrinsicRenderer.cs and the runtime CobolIntrinsics.*.cs for Edition|DialectLevel|CobolVersion|ConstructRegistry|DialectBehavior: the renderer's function dispatch and every runtime body consult no edition (the runtime Intrinsics folder has none); the generated C# at --std 85 and --std 2023 differs only in the assembly Edition attribute and the COMPUTE size-error wrapper (diff of var85-002/var85.g.cs vs var85-003, trig85-001 vs trig85-002)
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness's only ANNUITY is ANNUITY(1E-17 12), the nonzero arm; no witness exercises the zero arm (RV1)

probes.printed: COBOL1504 ANNUITY takes 2 arguments; COBOL1627 argument-2 2.5 not an integer; COBOL1627 argument-2 item with decimal places; COBOL1627 argument-1 alphanumeric

citations.check: OK  §1989:A.2.6.4 RV1  (cite.py --check with quoted words: "When the value of argument-1 is zero")
OK  §1989:A.2.3 GR2  (cite.py --check with quoted words: "Those characteristics of the returned value not otherwise specified for a given function are defined by the implementor")

reader.notes: Annuity(rate, periods) tests rate == 0 on the value after the exact domain screen and returns 1d/periods, so every written zero takes the RV1 arm; the emitted call is the same at 85 and 2023.

refuter.evidence: ann12-001: ANNUITY(0 4.00)=.25 (a literal with decimal places that always results in an integer is admitted per A.2.2 AR4 and takes the RV1 arm); annint-001: ANNUITY(0 FUNCTION MOD(7 4))=.3333333333 (integer function as argument-2), ANNUITY(0 N ** 2) N=3 = .1111111111; fnnames-001: ANNUITY(0 ANNUITY) with data item named ANNUITY = 2 gives .5. annmean-001: ANNUITY(.1 FUNCTION MEAN(2 4)) refused COBOL1627 (a numeric function where an integer is required, A.2.3 GR2). cite.py: OK §1989:A.2.6.4 RV1 ('When the value of argument-1 is zero'); OK §1989:A.2.2 AR4 ('An arithmetic expression which will always result in an integer value'); OK §1989:A.2.3 GR2 ('A numeric function may not be referenced where an integer operand is required').
